author: Traditionally John, the apostle and "the disciple whom Jesus loved"
authorNote: The Gospels do not name their authors; the names come from early church tradition, which scholars weigh differently.
overview: John's Gospel opens: "In the beginning was the Word." It tells fewer stories but in more depth, through seven "signs" and Jesus' "I am" sayings. It was written "so that you may believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God, and that by believing you may have life."
storyPlace: The fourth Gospel, with a different style from the other three.
